title: Codewars 5kyu: Human Readable Time
description: Write a function, which takes a non-negative integer (seconds) as input and returns the time in a human-readable format (HH:MM:SS). Maximum time never exceeds 359999 (99:59:59).
solution:
def make_readable(seconds: int) -> str:
    hh = seconds // 3600
    mm = (seconds % 3600) // 60
    ss = seconds % 60
    return f'{hh:02d}:{mm:02d}:{ss:02d}'
explanation: Decomposes total seconds into hours, minutes, and seconds in O(1) time.
